title: Compute GAE Advantages with Episode Boundaries

blocks.text: GAE carries advantage backward inside an episode and stops that recursion at every episode boundary. The task is: Compute GAE for a flat rollout. True termination removes value bootstrap; either termination or truncation ends the advantage recursion. next_values must contain final-observation values for truncated transitions.

The inputs are `rewards`, `values`, `next_values`, `terminated`, `episode_end`, `gamma`, `lam`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
